address: 1244 route de Brancion (Le Bourg), Ozenay, 71700, France
bio: In the picturesque medieval village of Ozenay, you cannot miss this colourful fronted inn. The contemporary interior provides the perfect foil to well-crafted cuisine by a chef who boasts a fine CV. His plating is particularly precise and flowery. Examples include velvety green peas, poached egg and an emulsion of smoked bacon. Fine view of the castle from one of the venue’s two terraces....
